verdict.rationale: Segment's docs explicitly document the tracking spec (track, identify, page) via the Segment Spec, show track() code examples, list official SDKs across languages/platforms (C#, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin/Android, Swift, and more), and describe 'Track once, send everywhere' as the core value proposition for web/mobile/server event collection. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK reliability across all platforms, and identify/page methods aren't explicitly shown in a code sample (only track is).
